name: Frigorific-Almagest
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near frozen methane lakes.
No wind, no voice, no weather: the landscape communicates in light and shadow alone, and it has plenty to say at sunrise.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
The next expedition is already fitting out. Whether it returns with data, ore, or just debts depends on choices nobody has made yet.
